_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4551 / req 60ed88e7 (vault-exodev task c223e6ef, RFC 14217015 P1.5): a SPARQL BIND extends the group prefix at its position. Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › Bn @req` (ITRV §A44/§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). Subject: FilterContainsOptimizer does not inject a UUID subject constraint into a group with a BIND — it takes the VALUES join, which constrains by merge. B32 (review round 3, M2: a subquery / UNION / VALUES operand next to a BIND) has NO single-anchor mutant here, by mechanism (ITRV §A138): with the guard off the injection still cannot descend into an Extend, so these shapes fall back to the VALUES join and stay correct; B32 reddens only under the round-2 code (descent into Extend + injection), which takes two edits. Its flip is the two-revision one: B32 red with FilterContainsOptimizer.ts from 6eb8c8c6, green with this revision (recorded in the PR body).

FC1_bind_group_injected._note: The subject constraint is injected into a group with a BIND: the injection cannot enter the Extend, so it constrains only the pattern after the BIND and drops the filter (B20: 416 rows instead of 8); a BIND that defines the filtered variable loses it (B24).
